cases.rationale: A large actual pizza fills the foreground on a plate at an eating table. Two stemmed glasses have identifiable bowls, stems and feet; the utensils at upper left include a fork with tines and a knife. Plates are not bowls, the glasses are not handleless cups, and the red illumination and napkin are not category objects. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual black, orange and white cat lies on a yellow surface, with a yellow gloved human hand supporting its paw at the lower right. The yellow lobed object is the worn glove rather than fruit; no other animal identity competes with the clear cat anatomy. The surface lacks dining-table context and the blurred background does not identify another category object. All 75 definitions considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual people sit and stand around set dining tables with individual chairs. A water bottle with a neck is on the foreground table; stemmed wine-glass forms and white drinking cups are visible. The black handled open container is an ice/wine bucket, not a bowl. The small light food pieces do not identify pizza, sandwich, cake or another defined food. Each definition was explicitly considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The room contains an upholstered sofa with a continuous multi-person seat and back, and growing plants in containers on the stand at right. The sofa is not a bed or individual chair. At far left, the small dark curved metal structure by the window is insufficiently resolved to distinguish chair parts from decorative railing, so chair remains unclear. The plant stand has no eating-table context and foliage is not cut flowers in a vase. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual baseball player crouches on the field wearing a large padded and laced fielding mitt on the lowered hand. The mitt is identifiable as a baseball glove rather than a batting glove or ordinary glove. The remaining crop shows uniform, shoes, dirt and grass; no other defined object is identifiable. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A small actual person with a dark head and upper body is visible amid the breaking wave near the center. A pale narrow shape beside the body may be a surfboard, but foam obscures its outline and does not permit a definite deck or rail identification; surfboard is unclear. No identifiable boat hull or other defined category is visible in the surrounding water. All 75 definitions were considered.

The left edge contains the furred body and paw of an actual cat. A brown glass bottle with a long neck stands beside a shiny metal pet bowl with an open rim and deep body. The bowl is not a sink or drinking cup; the cat graphic on the bottle does not add an animal judgment. The windowsill and floor do not establish a dining table. All definitions considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

Three actual people are shown standing outdoors and holding large oval strung tennis rackets with handles and tennis-clothing context. Their clothing and the background vegetation do not identify ties, bags or potted plants. This is the photographic scene itself, with no visible paper or screen hosting an excluded depicted object. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

The broad circular object is an actual flying disc, supported by its disc profile, concentric rim and printed Frisbeedisc marking rather than merely circular shape. Dark partly cropped material overlaps the lower rim and upper background. Its texture and tiny rounded portion at lower right do not let me confidently distinguish a dog muzzle/part from a gloved or clothed human part, so dog and person remain unclear. The mesh background alone does not identify a racket, chair or backpack. Every definition was considered.

An actual person reclines on an upholstered sofa with a continuous back and arm, not a bed. The hands hold a small white electronic object with a cord; its partially hidden face lacks enough button/screen detail to resolve a remote-type controller versus a phone or another handheld device. Remote and cell phone remain unclear. The cord and surrounding clothing do not establish other electronic or bag categories. All 75 definitions were considered.

A computer work area contains an open laptop at left, standalone monitors in the center, a computer keyboard below them and a mouse on the desk. Stacked bound books show covers/page blocks, a small growing plant has a container behind the stack, and part of an office chair is at lower left. The work desk lacks dining-table context. Lamps and pictures on displays/walls do not count as depicted category objects. All 75 definitions considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual person stands with a dark padded baseball fielding glove raised between the hands; its mitt-like pocket and fingers distinguish it from an ordinary worn glove. Flowering plants grow in identifiable rectangular containers along the railing, supporting potted plant rather than cut flowers in vases. The building windows and gravel add no other identifiable category objects. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.
